messages.subject: Project Northwind — A&R Agreement v3 (agreed form, redline vs v2)
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus, Claire,

Attached is v3 as a redline against the Bank's mark-up. We have moved to the middle on pricing (A 4.25%, B 6.50%, RCF 4.00%), held the covenant package at 3.50x→3.00x / DSCR 1.10x, set the liquidity floor at £1.5m, the amendment fee at £285k and the exit fee at 1.00%. We think this is the deal.

If the Bank is content we will produce a clean execution version and start chasing CPs. Marlow's final IBR is essentially ready.

Best,
Elena Marchetti
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
T +44 (0)20 7946 0534
